title_or_table: Biographical Directory of Article III Federal Judges, 1789 to present, export file federal-judicial-service.csv (active judges only)
observation_period: Judges in active service on the export’s latest record (latest commission date 2026-10-22), as retrieved November 11, 2026
geography: The 13 United States courts of appeals
universe_or_base: The 179 Article III judges in active service on a court of appeals in the frozen export, with no senior-status or termination date
unit: judges in active service, counted by Oath & Action
vintage: FJC export as posted on November 11, 2026; the file states no as-of date
qualification: A judge who takes senior status still hears cases but leaves this count, and vacant seats are not in the file, so a court’s count is below its authorized judgeships when a seat is open

court.description: the court as the directory names it

short_name.description: the court’s short name as a chart prints it (Ninth Circuit, D.C. Circuit, Federal Circuit), Oath & Action’s

circuit_order.description: the courts’ customary order, First Circuit 1 to Eleventh 11, D.C. Circuit 12, Federal Circuit 13

printed_source_line: Source: Federal Judicial Center, Biographical Directory of Article III Federal Judges, judges in active service on the 13 courts of appeals, as of November 11, 2026, United States. Retrieved November 11, 2026. Judges on senior status and vacant seats are not counted; judges counted by court by Oath & Action.
derivation: Rows of the frozen FJC file whose court_type is "U.S. Court of Appeals", counted by court_name; rows sorted by judges, most first, then by circuit_order
notes: Made November 12, 2026 for Rule 14.6’s plate (the editor’s request ED-R1). The 13 counts sum to 179, the file’s court of appeals rows.
